# Hill Bottom Properties

> Luxury Homes and Vibrant Communities in the Heart of Addis Ababa. Transparency. Timelines. Technical Excellence.

Hill Bottom Properties is a real estate developer based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia,
serving buyers both in Ethiopia and the Ethiopian diaspora (US, UK, Europe).

## Projects

- [Hill Bottom Village](https://hillbottomproperties.com/projects/hillbottom-village.html): Ayat Square, Addis Ababa — Block A Complete. Three phases at Ayat Square. Block A is complete and fully occupied. Block B delivers October 2026. Phase 3 — the Commercial & Recreation Center — opens January 2027.
- [Urban Kaza](https://hillbottomproperties.com/projects/urban-kaza.html): Kazanchis, near Addis Sport Park — In Progress. 98 exclusive residential apartments in Kazanchis — Addis Ababa's diplomatic corridor. Where African heritage meets cosmopolitan precision.
- [Hill Bottom Commercial + Recreation](https://hillbottomproperties.com/projects/recreation-center.html): Ayat, Addis Ababa — Phase 3 — Coming Jan 2027. A world-class commercial and recreation center: hair salon, steam sauna, Morocco bath, swimming pool, restaurant (club house), bakery, event space, children's playground and more.
